editorial:
Imagine every single magical girl from the first few seasons of the show teaming up for one giant party. That is exactly what you get here. You follow the Cures from the Suite series as they meet all their predecessors to save the world from a group of returning villains. The vibe is bright, loud, and full of energy, making it feel like a massive celebration of friendship. It is a colorful ride that doesn't take itself too seriously, focusing on the bond between the girls and their shared mission to protect the rainbow-colored flower.

You will love the huge battle scenes and the way the different teams interact with each other. While the plot is pretty simple and moves very quickly, the sheer amount of action keeps you glued to the screen. The only downside is that with so many characters, some of them do not get much screen time.
endingExplained: The movie ends with all the Cures combining their powers to create a massive burst of light and energy. They use the power of the rainbow flower to defeat the villains once and for all, proving that friendship is stronger than hate. After the big fight, everyone says their goodbyes and returns to their own worlds. You see the girls happy and hopeful, knowing the future is safe because they stood together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves magical girls and upbeat team-up movies.
